title: What does strict ZDR routing cost us in failed tasks?
hypothesis: Fewer than 3% of ZDR-class tasks reach the end of their chain without an answer, so strict routing is affordable.
human_gate: Frank decides the ZDR default; this experiment only supplies the number.

runs_on.why: Passive. Reads receipts that real work already writes.
The weekly review runs from receipts without calling any model.

suite: live receipts from two weeks of normal work
success_rule: Exhaustion under 3% keeps strict as the default. Over 10% means the chain needs another Token Pass model before any free fallback is allowed.
kill: None needed, spend is zero. Closes after 14 days of receipts or 40 ZDR-class tasks, whichever is later.
